name: Anhui Guofeng New Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Guofeng New Materials Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the plastic film production business in China and internationally. It operates through Thin Film Material Business, New Energy Vehicle Supporting Material Business, and New Wood-Plastic Material Business segments. The company offers BOPET, BOPP, and PI films; BOPET thermal, BOPP velvet touch, BOPP anti-scratch, no-primer type BOPP gloss and matte thermal, and BOPP digital thermal films; wood and plastic complex materials; and lightweight materials for new energy vehicles.
